verdict.rationale: Token2 offers a bulk enrollment tool that automates FIDO2 pre-registration into Entra ID via Microsoft's Graph API and PowerShell, showing some API-driven provisioning flow, but there is no evidence of Token2-owned enterprise APIs for key ordering or fleet-wide assignment, and probes confirm no public OpenAPI/swagger spec or machine-readable docs. missing for 10: documented Token2 ordering API, assignment/inventory API, machine-readable API spec (openapi.json returns 404), evidence of end-to-end agent-driven provisioning beyond registration.
